title: Public-service enquiry form
story: A council service takes enquiries, validates them, and shows the enquirer their reference.

durability.basis: transcribed from the pilot archetype and hand-reviewed; test/spec.test.mjs keeps the two in step

state.lifetime: per process, in a file named on the command line - not a durable store

tables.name: records
tables.purpose: the value a write stores, read back by the reference the server issued

persistence.reference: server-issued reference, returned in the Location header of a 303
persistence.reload_assertion: reloading /enquiry/<ref> still shows the stored message text

routes.effect: refuse the submission if a required field is missing; otherwise store the enquiry and redirect
read the enquiry by reference and show the message back to the enquirer

validation.on_missing: the server refuses the submission and re-renders the form; nothing is stored
validation.on_success: insert one row into records and answer 303 with Location: /enquiry/<ref>

acceptance: after a successful submit the browser lands on /enquiry/<ref> and the echoed message is present
reloading that URL still shows it
an empty submit is observed to be refused
